summary: Idun Industrier AB (publ), an investment holding company, invests in and develops industrial and service businesses in Sweden, rest of Nordic countries, rest of Europe, and internationally. It offers safety and evaluator services; glass fiber reinforced fat- and oil separators; stainless-steel furnishings, kitchen machines, and related equipment, as well as stoves, heating cabinets, heaters, cookers, dispensers, air purification systems, and ovens; and coffins and urns. The company is also involved in the trading of concrete separators; preventive maintenance services of high-voltage substations; distribution of mechanical components and machine parts; and measurements and analyses of air and flue gas. In addition, it provides load attachments to grip, cut, saw, or weigh loads; actuators for vehicle mounted tail lifts; micronutrients and fertilizers to commercial greenhouse growers, farmers, golf courses, and peat producers; analysis of soil, water, and plant sap; and sports and training water bottles. Further, the company offers learning and competence management tools for industrial companies and vocational upper secondary school programs; manufactures and supplies wooden workbenches and cabinets for primary schools; acquires and develops small and medium sized quality companies; and provides maintenance of pumps, pipes, composite coatings, and seals for heavy industry, water towers, water and sewerage facilities, and heating and power plants. Additionally, it engages in the provision of technical advice, design, and manufacturing of rollers for industrial companies; manufacture of small and medium sized turbines, as well as provides maintenance and refurbishment services for renewable hydropower installations; and development, optimization, and sale of technical components and products. Idun Industrier AB (publ) was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
